jobs.occupation: Senior Data & AI Engineer for Life Science & Pharma
jobs.description:
Discover your future with DAQUMA

At DAQUMA, we're changing the way consultancy works – a flat, transparent culture built on trust, where ideas matter more than titles. We're not just looking for employees, but individuals who take ownership, challenge the status quo, and speak their mind. We don't just offer a job – we offer a place to grow, lead, and help redefine consultancy.

Our Core Values

What we stand for

Execution over Complexity

We prioritize tangible progress and real outcomes over unnecessary complexity. Our focus is on execution - delivering value fast.

Progress through Innovation

We continuously challenge the status quo and embrace new ideas, technologies, and ways of working. Innovation is not an end but a means to drive meaningful progress

Brave and Bold

We act with ownership and speak our minds. We take clear positions, challenge poor practices, and believe there is a right and a wrong way of doing things – especially in life sciences

Trust is Our Foundation

We work in a flat, inclusive, and democratic environment where ideas matter more than titles. Built on transparency and mutual trust, we collaborate with confidence and respect

Open Positions

Current Opportunities

Senior Data & AI Engineer for Life Science & Pharma

Copenhagen NV, Denmark

Full-time

Join DAQUMA as a Senior Data & AI Engineer, where you will develop data pipelines, deliver data migrations, and build AI and cloud-based solutions for clients in the Life Science and Pharma industries.

Key Requirements:

• 
5+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud engineering, data migration or similar roles

• 
Strong Python skills and experience with ETL/ELT pipelines and data processing

• 
Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure or AWS

• 
Knowledge of SQL, APIs, databases and integration technologies

• 
Experience in Life Science, Pharma or GxP-regulated environments is an advantage

• 
A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and strong client communication skills

Apply now

Junior Technical Project Manager for Life Science & Pharma Industry

Germany

Full-time

As a Junior Technical Project Manager, you will support DAQUMA’s life science and pharma clients with various execution and advisory tasks across GxP and non-GxP projects, primarily within IT, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, and R&D.

You will engage in diverse projects, enhancing your skills across a wide range of areas based on your interests and expertise.

Key Requirements:

• Project Management and/or Business Analysis experience.

• Good stakeholder management and communication skills.

• Experience working with cross-functional teams and workshops.

• Ability to manage dependencies and multiple deliverables.

• Good documentation and requirements management capabilities.

• A structured, proactive, and delivery-focused mindset.

• Experience with technology refresh, upgrade, migration, or modernization projects is preferred.

• Experience from pharmaceutical, biotech, or other regulated industries is preferred.

• Familiarity with GxP environments and validation-related processes is an advantage.

• Exposure to data platforms, system integrations, and enterprise applications is preferred.

• Experience working with global teams across business and IT functions is preferred.

Apply now

Don't see your role?

We’re always looking for talented and driven individuals who want to make an impact. Ifyou feel that DAQUMA is a great match for you and believe you could be a valuable addition to our team, we'd love to hear from you. Please feel free to send us an unsolicited application.

_Are you passionate about ensuring complex IoT and connectivity solutions perform reliably before reaching customers? Do you thrive at the intersection of system architecture, embedded firmware, verification, and AI? And do you want to help shape the future of verification and validation for connected products in a modern engineering organization?

**Here Is What The Job Entails

**As our Test Manager, Connectivity Solutions, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, performance, and release readiness of our connectivity products, embedded firmware, and integrated solutions.

Working closely with Solution Architects, Systems Engineers, Firmware Developers, and Hardware Engineers, you will drive verification activities across disciplines and help shape the future of testing within the Water Division.

More specifically, you will be:

• Defining and driving the verification strategy throughout the product lifecycle

• Leading verification activities across firmware, hardware, connectivity, and integrated solutions

• Ensuring traceability, test coverage, and alignment from requirements to release readiness

• Driving AI-enabled verification, test automation, and modern quality engineering practices

• Building and strengthening the capabilities, processes, and governance supporting the future test organization within the Water Division

Combine hands-on technical impact with strategic influence as you drive verification excellence, shape future testing practices, and help bring innovative connected solutions safely to market.

**Meet your future team

**Reporting to the Director of Connectivity, you will join the Solutions Architect team within the Water Division. Working alongside specialists in connectivity, embedded systems, wireless communication, system architecture, and product development, you will help ensure our solutions are verified and validated before release.

You will be part of an informal and collaborative environment characterized by strong technical expertise, knowledge sharing, and a shared commitment to delivering high-quality solutions to our customers.

**Less About Us, More About You

**We are looking for a Test Manager who thrives in complex engineering environments and brings structure, quality, and continuous improvement to the verification of connected solutions. Combining analytical thinking with a pragmatic approach, you are comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying risks, and driving quality through collaboration, automation, and emerging technologies.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Hold a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Embedded Systems, Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, and have experience testing embedded, firmware-based, connected, or IoT products

• Understand systems integration, and acceptance testing and can develop effective verification strategies and test plans from product requirements and used cases

• Have hands-on experience with Python, embedded C, test automation, and embedded systems debugging

• Collaborate effectively across hardware, firmware, connectivity, and software domains with both specialists and project stakeholders

• Take ownership, communicate clearly, and drive continuous improvements through automation, AI-enabled verification, and modern quality engineering

Experience with wireless communication technologies, Grafana, test management tools, requirements management, systems engineering practices, or AI-assisted verification is considered an advantage.

As we are an international organization it is important that you are fluent in English.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, you could still be a good candidate for the position. If you find the role intriguing, do not hesitate to apply.

**We are more than an ordinary workplace

**We cherish the good colleagueship which we all contribute to, the only limit is your engagement. As we are a big organization you are bound to find one or more colleagues who share the same interest as you. This might be in our board game club, on our cycling team, during our yearly summer festival, or on the padel court. For example, our Team lead, Service Delivery is also our volunteer padel instructor while one of our Software Test Engineers run weekly spinning classes.

Besides the best colleagues you could imagine, we also offer:

• Work life balance through flexible working hours

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

• Beneficial health care and insurance package

**Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

**Please submit your application by using the link below. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, and you can expect a response within six weeks.

The job will be located at Kamstrup's headquarters in Stilling, between Aarhus and Skanderborg.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Director, Connectivity, Kristen Kasper Hansen, on phone: +45 89 93 10 00.

**_Get to know us

_**_At Kamstrup, you'll become part of a close-knit community that genuinely cares about one another, fostering connections both in and out of the workplace. Our team comprises innovators, dreamers, and doers, united by an unyielding passion to challenge the status quo, find better solutions, and constantly push the boundaries of what's possible by being driving by our purpose: We Make What You Measure Matter. With an unwavering commitment to growth, we offer opportunities for you to leverage your skills and drive our business to new heights, empowering you to leave your mark on our future and grow with us.

_Explore more on our website, see our annual report, and stay updated through LinkedIn for the latest news and job openings.

Help shape operational excellence across our global logistics network

Do you want to help create smarter, more connected and future-ready logistics operations across Arla?

In this senior leadership role, you will play a key part in shaping operational excellence across our global logistics network. Working closely with colleagues across sites, markets and central functions, you will help translate strategy into practical standards, processes and solutions while strengthening the capabilities needed to support consistent and sustainable operational performance.

“You will lead our Operational Excellence team and  collaborate closely with logistics sites, market teams and central functions. Together, you will develop, test and embed solutions across both insourced- and outsourced operations,” says Jakob Hartvig, Head of Center of Excellence – Logistics.

How you will make an impact

As Head of Operational Excellence in Logistics CoE, you will help connect global ambition with local execution. You will inspire and provide functional leadership across the logistics network, create clarity on priorities and responsibilities, and work with stakeholders to ensure that improvements  create meaningful and measurable operational value.

In this role you will

• Shape and drive the global strategy and long-term roadmap for logistics operational excellence, aligning priorities and resources across sites, markets and functions.

• Define, implement and continuously improve common logistics standards, SOPs, playbooks and process taxonomy, while strengthening continuous improvement capabilities through approaches such as Lean, A3 and PDCA.

• Develop  and embed the Arla Performance System for logistics, including performance meeting standards, operational KPIs, dashboards, benchmarking and links to financial performance and the SQCDMP balanced scorecard.

• Further advance on the digital transformation of logistics by identifying, assessing and scaling high-value use cases across AI, machine learning, IoT, automation and other smart logistics technologies.

Foster a strong operational excellence network across Arla, by supporting capability building,  change adoption while drawing on external insights and proof-of-concept activities.

What  will help you succeed

You bring  experience within operational excellence, continuous improvement,  logistics transformation or a related field, and you are motivated by creating sustainable improvements in complex environments . You are comfortable working across organizational and geographical boundaries and understand the importance of balancing global consistency with local needs.

You combine strategic thinking with a practical mindset and enjoy engaging with diverse stakeholders to create solutions that work in practice.

We imagine that you bring

• Relevant experience within operational excellence, supply chain, logistics

• A degree in Economics, Supply Chain or related field or equivalent experience

• Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and data-driven performance management frameworks.

• Experience with digital transformation, automation or smart logistics solutions. Leadership experience, either through people leadership or matrix environments

• Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills

As a leader, you create  direction by translating complexity into clear priorities and actionable plans. You build trust by listening and being curious, involving local market stakeholders and adapting solutions where appropriate. At the same time, you maintain focus on delivering sustainable outcomes and continuous improvements.

What do we offer?

This is an opportunity to shape the future of logistics across Arla and create impact at network scale. You will work with experienced colleagues across markets, sites and central functions, combining global perspectives with practical operational expertise. The role offers broad exposure, meaningful transformation opportunities and the chance to contribute to the development of people, processes and digital solutions that strengthen safety, quality, service, cost and sustainability performance.

We are committed to professional development and a collaborative culture where knowledge is shared and improvements are built together. You will join a farmer-owned, international business with a clear purpose and the ambition to make nutritious dairy products while continuously improving how we operate.

Would you like to join us?

Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we process applications on an ongoing basis and close the recruitment once we have found the right candidate.

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Jakob Hartvig, Head of Logistics Center of Excellence, at jakob.hartvig@arlafoods.com

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

jobs.occupation: Operational Network Planner - Viby J or Krusaa
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about supply chain planning within an End-2-End perspective and motivated by making operational decisions that create value across the entire value chain? Do you thrive in a collaborative environment where customer focus, stakeholder management and data-driven decision-making go hand in hand? Then this could be the opportunity for you. We are looking for an Operational Network Planner for CBP Krusaa cluster.

“Joining the Krusaa Cluster Planning team, you will be part of planning the supply of speciality cheese products across a complex and dynamic supply chain. Working closely with Supply Chain, Commercial and Production, you will help connect customer demand with production and supply. If you thrive in an operational environment, enjoy collaborating across functions and want to make a real impact, this could be the opportunity for you” says Christine Carstensen, Supply Chain Network Planning Manager.

The role can be based either in Krusaa or Viby J. To support close collaboration with the planning team and production sites, colleagues based in Viby J are expected to spend a minimum of one day per week in Krusaa.

Read more about Supply Chain at Arla here Inside Arla.

How you will make an impact

As an Operational Network Planner, you will play a key role within the Sales & Operations Execution (S&OE) horizon, ensuring that we deliver excellent service levels to customers while balancing production capacity, inventory levels and waste reduction across markets and warehouses.

You will join a highly collaborative planning team consisting of 6 Site Schedulers, two Operational Network Planners and one Component Planner, supporting five production sites. Working closely with colleagues across Supply Chain, Commercial and Production, you will help drive operational decisions that create value across the end-to-end supply chain.

Your key responsibilities will include

• Optimizing supply chain performance through root cause analysis and data-driven decisions.

• Monitoring relevant KPIs and implementing corrective actions to achieve targets.

• Conducting scenario planning to mitigate availability risks, reduce waste, and assess the impact of demand fluctuations on finished goods.

• Escalating unresolved short-term imbalances to global or local S&OE executive forums and key stakeholders.

• Leading proactive dialogue between Supply Chain and Commercial teams to solve complex issues.

• Identifying and contributing to optimization initiatives from an end-to-end perspective.

What will make you successful

You are an ambitious and structured professional with strong analytical skills and the ability to work across multiple functions. You thrive on collaboration and have a natural ability to engage with stakeholders from across the business.

You are motivated by change and actively contribute to the continuous improvement of ways of working and collaboration.

We imagine you

• Hold a relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree within Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Business or a related field.

• Have experience within supply chain planning, logistics or manufacturing, preferably working within S&OE or short-term planning horizons.

• Are comfortable analysing data and using insights to support operational decisions.

• Communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders across different functions and organisational levels.

• Are curious, proactive and motivated by continuous improvement and optimisation.

• Are able to communicate effectively both in Danish and in English

What do we offer?

An inclusive corporate culture that creates job satisfaction is important to us, and we prioritize giving our employees good development opportunities. We are looking for you who want to grow with us at Arla Foods!

Arla Foods has a collective agreement and always offers good and competitive working conditions. In addition, we have a high priority on safety and the working environment.

About Arla

We are Arla – a European dairy cooperative with over 19,000 employees and around 8,600 farmers. Our cooperative model creates a unique closeness to our farmers – the owners of Arla – and motivates us every day to deliver the very best for our farmers, colleagues, our milk, our consumers, and our environment.

Would you like to join us?

Please apply as soon as possible. We process applications on a continuous basis and close the position once the right candidate has been found.

If you have any questions, please contact Supply Chain Network Planning Manager, Christine Carstensen at +45 91 31 58 03.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

Join a team of highly skilled Data & AI specialists and help build the platforms that power the future of data, analytics and AI across the organisation. If you are passionate about modern data platforms, AI technologies and platform engineering, this is an opportunity to shape scalable solutions while enabling others to innovate and deliver impact at scale.

Meet your future team

You will join the Data & AI Platforms team, responsible for the shared foundation that supports data, analytics and AI use cases across the organisation.

The team owns and develops the core Data & AI platform landscape, including our Snowflake-based data platform, dbt, GenAI Hub, AI Gateway, Cortex Agents and emerging agentic AI capabilities. We continuously evaluate new technologies, tools and ways of working to provide secure, scalable and developer-friendly platforms that empower teams across the business.

As a Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer, you will play a central role in designing, building and operating these platforms. You will collaborate closely with Data Engineers, AI Solutions Partners, Data Scientists and other technology specialists, helping them build and deploy data products and AI solutions efficiently and securely.

What We Offer

As a Senior Data & AI Platform Engineer, you will take ownership of core platform capabilities within both Data and AI. You will work hands-on with modern technologies while influencing platform architecture, engineering standards and future technology choices.

More specifically your tasks will be to:

• Build, operate and continuously evolve our Snowflake and dbt-based Data Platform, enabling teams to develop, deploy and operate data products and AI applications independently.

• Design and develop core Data & AI platform capabilities, including Cortex Agents, AI governance, observability, security, access management and developer experience.

• Define platform architecture, engineering standards and best practices across the Data & AI landscape.

• Drive reliability, scalability and cost optimisation across Data and AI workloads, including FinOps initiatives and platform governance.

• Coach and support Data Engineers and AI Solutions Partners by promoting reusable building blocks, platform patterns and engineering best practices.

What You Will Bring

You are an experienced platform engineer who enjoys building robust foundations that others can build on. You thrive in complex technical environments, stay curious about emerging technologies and are motivated by enabling teams through scalable platform capabilities.

Moreover, we expect that you:

• Have 5+ years of experience designing, building and operating production-grade data platforms.

• Bring deep expertise in Snowflake and dbt.

• Have strong Python skills and experience working with SQL, Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD practices.

• Have experience with modern AI and LLM infrastructure, such as model gateways, retrieval systems and agent frameworks.

• Understand data mesh principles, semantic modelling and data contracts.

• Have experience supporting large numbers of users while balancing reliability, security and cost efficiency.

• Enjoy collaborating with and mentoring other engineers and technical stakeholders.

• Have a structured and pragmatic approach to solving complex technical challenges.

Ready to apply?

Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match.

All inquiries will be treated confidentially.

About VELUX

In the VELUX Group, we offer you a world of opportunities and the chance to create a bright future. From the forefront of the roof window category, we enable those who live, work and play under the roof transform their spaces and live a healthier everyday life with more daylight and fresh air.

The VELUX Group is an international, family-owned business with strong financial roots and each year we can create real impact by reinvesting in society, our employees and planet through our foundations. With 20 production companies in 12 countries and sales companies in 37 countries, our products are widely available. We employ around 12,000 people, and our company is headquartered in Denmark. Alongside the rest of our values, “courage” and “mutual respect” define our actions every day and how we wish to contribute to the world.

Equal Opportunity Employer

In the VELUX Group, we believe in fostering a diverse workplace for everyone to thrive, develop, and perform at their best, and where you feel welcome, respected, and valued. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all, whether you are applying for a role or already a part of VELUX. That means we recruit, hire, train, and promote people based on their skills and potential without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, age, neurodiversity, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We value diversity and strive to ensure that our employment decisions are fair and inclusive, focusing only on what truly matters: your qualifications and how you can contribute to our shared mission and success.

At our historic waterfront home, we believe that true hospitality isn't just about checking boxes, it’s about the way a person feels the moment they walk through our doors. We are looking for a Guest Relations Officer who doesn't just provide service, but creates a sense of belonging.

Including you, the Guest Relations team will consist of three colleagues and together, you will be the soul of the lobby, sharing ideas, supporting one another, and brainstorming those creative "wow" moments that define the Admiral Experience. If you value a workplace where your voice is heard and your personality is your greatest asset, you’ll fit right in.

The Role: The Heart of the House

As our Guest Relations Officer you are the guardian of the guest’s journey. Your mission is to turn a standard hotel stay into an "Admiral Experience."

Whether you are welcoming a long-time regular back home or orchestrating a "wow" moment for a couple celebrating their 50th anniversary, you do it with a blend of professional grace and genuine, human warmth.

Your key responsibilities;

• 
You’ll be the friendly face our VIPs and loyalty members look for, building relationships that go beyond a simple "hello."

• 
You’ll have the creative freedom to identify special milestones and craft personalized gestures that stay with guests long after they’ve checked out.

• 
You’ll collaborate closely with our Housekeeping, F&B, and Concierge teams to ensure that every detail of a guest's stay is seamless.

• 
When things don't go perfectly, you’re the calm in the storm. You listen with empathy and turn feedback into a reason for a guest to return.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

• 
Truly enjoy making people feel special and seen.

• 
Can communicate our hotel’s historic charm with passion.

• 
Have  at least 2 years of experience in luxury hospitality or high-end guest service.

• 
Are tech-comfortable - we use Mews, so experience there (or a quick ability to learn) is a plus.

• 
Notice when a pillow is slightly askew or when a guest looks a bit lost before they even have to ask for help.

Why Admiral Hotel?

At Admiral Hotel, you will become part of an open and collaborative environment where you have the opportunity to make a personal difference in both our operation and development. We place great emphasis on employee well-being and are proud to maintain a high level of engagement and job satisfaction across the organization. This is something we can clearly see reflected in our results – and just as importantly, something you can feel when you walk through the hotel.

The position includes:

• 
A full time position starting as soon as possible, with start date flexibility for the ideal candidate.

• 
Access to our Super Colleague Program, granting up to 4 free stays per year at our hotels and resorts in the Nordics together with a lot of attractive food and beverage discounts.

• 
Massage scheme and a wide selection of employee discounts to support your well-being.

• 
Dedicated colleagues who value collaboration, positivity, and a strong sense of community—here, we support each other in both big and small tasks to ensure an enjoyable workday.

Ready to join us?

Submit your application using the form below. We look forward to hearing from you!

Admiral is situated in the heart of Copenhagen, where the sea meets the city, and where Copenhagen meets the world. Housed in a historic 18th-century warehouse along the scenic harbor, Admiral blends modern elegance with rich history creating authentic warmth. At Admiral, we strive for ambitious excellence in everything we do – from the smallest details to the most memorable guest experiences and with a culture rooted in attentive hospitality, we create a sense of home, where every interaction is infused with genuine care and a passion for service.

Admiral is more than a place to stay in Copenhagen. It’s a place to be.

jobs.occupation: Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer
jobs.description:
**Lead a global compliance function and help shape how compliance enables the business

**Are you an experienced compliance, privacy or GRC leader who enjoys operating at the intersection of regulation, business and technology?

Do you thrive in a role where you can set direction, lead experienced professionals, advise Executive Management and the Board, and turn complex requirements into practical solutions?

Then this could be your opportunity to lead Aeven's Group Compliance function.

**The role

**As Head of Group Compliance & Group Data Protection Officer, you will lead the Global Group Compliance organisation of approximately 27 professionals across four teams and three countries.

You will have overall responsibility for the strategy, direction and development of the function, covering:

• Group Data Protection and the DPO function

• Regulatory Compliance

• Enterprise Risk Management

• Internal Audit

• ISO and external assurance

• Customer and supplier assurance

• Responsibility / ESG

You will lead primarily through your managers, creating clear priorities and accountability while empowering highly specialised teams to own their areas.

The role combines strategic leadership, independent oversight and senior business advisory. You will work closely with Executive Management and the Board, providing a consolidated view of Aeven's compliance, privacy, risk and assurance position and highlighting where action or decisions are required.

At the same time, you will work closely with the business to translate regulatory and customer requirements into clear, proportionate and commercially workable solutions.

****Your responsibilities

• Set the strategy, priorities and roadmap for Group Compliance and lead, coach and develop the management team.

• Advise Executive Management and the Board on significant compliance, privacy and risk matters and provide clear, decision-oriented Management Information.

• Act as Group DPO and oversee Aeven's data protection framework, including significant privacy risks, breaches, regulatory engagement and international transfers.

• Lead the organisation's approach to regulatory developments, including GDPR, NIS2, DORA-related customer requirements, AI Act, Data Act and digital sovereignty.

• Own the Enterprise Risk Management framework and consolidated enterprise risk view, while ensuring risk ownership remains with the business.

• Oversee Internal Audit and Aeven's broader certification and assurance landscape, including ISO and ISAE activities.

• Provide senior oversight of customer and supplier due diligence, audits and regulatory assurance requirements.

• Support significant incidents, investigations, escalations and remediation across the organisation.

• Continuously develop and modernise the function through simplification, automation, better Management Information and effective use of compliance technology.

A key part of the role is ensuring that compliance enables the business rather than unnecessarily slowing it down.

****Your experience

****We are looking for an experienced leader who is comfortable operating where regulation, risk and business strategy meet.

You bring:

• A relevant Master's degree, for example in Law, Business/Commercial Law or a related field.

• 10+ years of experience within compliance, data protection, GRC or a related area, including several years leading managers and international or multi-disciplinary teams.

• Strong GDPR and data protection expertise, including DPO experience.

• Proven experience advising C-level executives and Boards and communicating complex risks through clear Management Information.

• Experience with Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Audit and assurance.

• Working knowledge of ISO management systems (ISO9001, ISO27001 and ISO14001) and ideally ISAE 3000/3402 reporting.

• Knowledge of EU digital and cyber regulation, including NIS2, DORA, AI Act and Data Act.

• Excellent written and spoken English.

Experience from an international, regulated or technology-driven organisation is an advantage, as is experience with privacy certification, GRC technology, customer assurance, ESG or transformation.

**Who You Are

**You are a trusted and credible advisor who can challenge senior stakeholders constructively while building strong relationships across the organisation.

You lead through trust, clear direction and empowerment, and enjoy developing managers and creating high-performing teams.

You are strategic but pragmatic, with strong business understanding and the judgement to balance regulatory robustness with commercial realities.

You communicate complex issues simply, drive follow-through and are comfortable raising risks and challenging established ways of working.

Most importantly, you bring integrity, sound judgement, independence and a genuine desire to make compliance work for the business.

**Why Aeven?

**This is an opportunity to take on a broad and influential leadership role at the centre of Aeven's governance and business operations.

You will lead a highly skilled international team, work directly with senior leadership and the Board, and help shape how a technology-driven organisation responds to an increasingly complex regulatory environment.

If you are motivated by leadership, influence, complexity and the opportunity to make compliance a genuine business enabler, we would like to hear from you.

Location: Ballerup 2750, Denmark

Contract type: Permanent

Job ID: 4513

Role Description

**Join us in creating a future legacy in medical dermatology

At LEO Pharma, we are global leaders in medical dermatology. We have 115 years’ experience in bringing innovation to healthcare. And we are eager to do much more. Each year, close to 100 million people have a better day because of our medicines.

**In Global Regulatory Affairs we share a “challenge accepted” mindset and are guided by our winning behaviours of simplification, collaboration, and accountability, to achieve our goals.

**Your role

**As a Regulatory Business Development Lead, you will support the identification, evaluation, and progression of external innovation opportunities, ensuring robust regulatory assessments, clear value-creation perspectives, and efficient use of internal expertise to support LEO Pharma’s business development goals.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Providing expert regulatory input into portfolio and pipeline strategy, evaluation, and acceleration.

• Leading the planning and execution of regulatory due diligence activities across internal and external assets.

• Conducting comprehensive global regulatory assessments covering clinical, nonclinical, CMC, and regional requirements.

• Identifying regulatory risks, gaps, and opportunities, and developing mitigation strategies to maximise the probability of technical and regulatory success.

• Driving efficient, structured due diligence processes to optimise resource use across the portfolio.

• Delivering clear regulatory risk-benefit assessments and actionable recommendations to governance bodies.

• Partnering with Search & Evaluation and Business Development teams to embed regulatory insights into deal strategy and valuation.

• Engaging with external partners and Health Authorities.

• Contributing to the development of best practices for regulatory involvement in business development and asset evaluation.

**Your Qualifications

**To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have the following qualifications:

• Advanced degree in a scientific field (PharmD, PhD, MD, MSc).

• 10 years of global regulatory experience in the pharmaceutical or biotech industries.

• Proven track record in driving business development regulatory excellence within a search and evaluation development model.

• Demonstrated expertise in due diligence activities, regulatory risk assessment, and pipeline-building initiatives.

• In-depth knowledge of global regulatory systems and pathways.

• Experience collaborating with external partners, Health Authorities, and cross-functional teams.

• Strategic and operational mindset with the ability to navigate fast-paced environments and balance multiple priorities and proven problem-solving capability within drug development.

**Contact and Application

****While this position is based in our HQ in Denmark, we are also open to a hybrid work setup across Europe, enabling you to contribute from your location while fostering close collaboration with the global team.

****Your application

**If this exciting opportunity aligns with your expertise, we’d love to hear from you!

You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to include a few sentences in your CV about why this position excites you. Please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

**Beyond the skin

**Join LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. Our innovative approach sets us apart. We are dedicated to leaving a legacy that positively impacts patients, colleagues, and our planet.

At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a difference.

For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party.

Report a concern: Whistleblower hotline | LEO Pharma

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp! At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered. If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important to us

**_Are you ready to thrive in a dynamic, global environment? SimCorp offers a unique opportunity to join our finance team as a Group Transfer Pricing Director.

_For over five decades, SimCorp has been at the forefront of providing integrated investment management solutions. With a global team of over 4000 professionals from diverse backgrounds, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and innovative workplace.

The Group Transfer Pricing Director will be an integral part of our tax team, a specialized subset within Group Finance. Our team is responsible for overseeing the tax and transfer pricing compliance and strategy across all 40+ SimCorp entities.

Based at our headquarters in Copenhagen, this role offers an exciting opportunity to shape SimCorp's transfer pricing strategy and ensure compliance across our global operations.

Reporting directly to the Global Head of Tax, your primary responsibility will be to lead the transfer pricing team and devise SimCorp's transfer pricing strategies. Your team will be responsible for the tax modeling, documentation, and devising transfer pricing procedures.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As a Group Transfer Pricing Director, you will play a critical role in supporting SimCorp’s global organization by providing transfer pricing solutions. Your work will involve analyzing and enhancing transfer pricing structures, ensuring compliance with global regulations, and continuously implementing improvements in our transfer pricing models.

You will be responsible for reviewing the transfer pricing documentation for SimCorp A/S and its subsidiaries. This includes leading the team to draft reports, collect and analyze financial data, and collaborate with subsidiaries' finance teams and other internal stakeholders to ensure accurate and compliant reporting. We take pride in contributing to SimCorp’s growth through high-quality work. We value a collaborative working environment where we balance hard work with an approachable and collaborative spirit.

As a Group Transfer Pricing Director, you will:

• Devise new transfer pricing policies and update existing policies to ensure compliance with OECD guidelines and local regulations.

• Develop vision, strategy and structure of the group’s transfer pricing models in the rapidly changing environment, including APAs.

• Guide the transfer pricing team to prepare and maintain comprehensive transfer pricing documentation for SimCorp A/S and its subsidiaries in collaboration with the finance teams.

• Review changes in global transfer pricing legislations and ensure the group’s transfer pricing models are efficient and compliant.

• Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders, including finance, legal, and business, to ensure effective transfer pricing practices.

• Lead and manage transfer pricing projects, drive change, secure stakeholder buy-in, and ensure high-quality deliverables and outstanding results.

• Represent the group on transfer pricing audits and dispute resolution and influence decisions in complex negotiations with tax authorities globally

• Provide excellent and timely support to our business team and finance team on intercompany transactions such as transfers of intangible property, services, and loans.

• Develop a mature control framework to ensure transfer pricing documentation, returns, notifications, intercompany agreements and related deliverables are maintained.

• Collaborate closely with Group Finance, subsidiary finance teams to ensure that TP policies are accounted for correctly in the Group books during quarter end and year end closing, and local statutory account.

• Provide training to stakeholders both in finance and to business team on transfer pricing policies and changes in legislation.

• Manage external service providers and liaise with our statutory auditors on TP matters.

**What We Value

**Experience and Education:

• Minimum 10 years experience in industry and/or consultancy with emphasis on working with multinational groups.

• Relevant education such as lawyer, CPA, economist or education from tax administration or any combination thereof.

Skills and Knowledge:

• Excellent understanding and experience in dealing with international taxation and transfer pricing, OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines, BEPS and local rules and regulations.

• Proven ability to lead complex transfer pricing projects, drive the team to deliver impactful results, and foster a positive, collaborative environment where team members and stakeholders feel engaged and valued.

• Act as an owner with a proactive approach to set directions, drive changes and improvements in transfer pricing practices.

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong relations with internal stakeholders and teams.

• Excellent communication skills and able to communicate complicated issues in a precise and concise manner.

• Strong team player who can influence others and the ability to work independently.

• Good general accounting/finance skills and experience. Experience with financial systems (ERP, consolidation tools and management reporting tools) is a plus.

• Advanced communication skills, with fluency in English (both verbal and written). Knowledge of the Danish tax system is a plus.

• Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and other MS Office tools.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients. SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

jobs.occupation: Senior OT/IT Network & Infrastructure Architect | Customer Assignments Across Denmark
jobs.description:
This is a consulting role with customer assignments across Denmark. You can be based anywhere in Denmark, provided you can work regularly on-site with customers, primarily in Greater Copenhagen, the Kolding/Fredericia area, and Central Jutland.

As a Senior OT/IT Network & Infrastructure Architect at Opoura, you will work as a consultant in customer environments where experienced technical judgment is needed. You will typically take responsibility for complex OT/IT infrastructure challenges that span architecture, implementation, and transition into reliable operations.

When a suitable assignment is confirmed, you will join Opoura in a permanent position and work primarily with the customer, usually on assignments lasting 6-12 months or longer.

We are currently seeing increasing demand for this level of expertise and already have active customer needs and concrete opportunities where relevant Architects may come into consideration. We are therefore building a talent pool of experienced profiles so we can move quickly when there is a strong match between a customer need and your background.

This is not a vacancy tied to one specific customer or immediate start date. The opportunity depends on the right assignment, but when the match is there, the process can move quickly.

Your role

You will join OT Solutions within Opoura’s Digital Services Business Unit and work closely with customer specialists, operations teams, suppliers, engineers, and other technical stakeholders.

Most assignments will place you directly within an existing customer environment. That means understanding the infrastructure already in place, identifying what needs to change, and helping the customer make technical decisions that work not only on paper, but also in implementation and day-to-day operations.

The role is deliberately broad enough for you to work across architecture and technical detail. You might be defining an infrastructure design, reviewing network segmentation, resolving gaps before operational handover, or helping improve the way recurring infrastructure activities are standardized and automated.

You will report to Kent Weiling, OT Solutions Manager, who will remain your direct manager and point of contact for sparring and alignment.

Our customers within this area are currently concentrated in Greater Copenhagen, the Triangle Region and Central Jutland. You should expect to work at the customer site around 2-3 days per week, depending on the assignment, combined with remote work and occasional time at Opoura’s headquarters in Silkeborg. International travel is not expected.

Your main responsibilities

Depending on the customer assignment, you will:

• Own OT/IT network and infrastructure solutions from technical assessment and architecture through implementation and operational handover.

• Design, assess, and troubleshoot industrial networks, including routing, switching, VLANs, segmentation, firewalls, VPNs, remote access, and site connectivity.

• Drive technical site intake and operational readiness, including documentation, access, monitoring, ownership, maintainability, and closure of identified gaps.

• Contribute senior expertise during implementation, commissioning, migrations, and complex root-cause analysis together with customer teams, suppliers, and operations.

• Improve lifecycle management, standardization, and automation through reusable designs, Infrastructure as Code, source-of-truth data, templates, and automated validation where relevant.

To be successful in this position, you

Understand complex existing environments quickly and distinguish between what needs to change and what can remain.

• Move comfortably between architecture-level decisions and configuration-level detail.

• Build credibility with customers through clear reasoning, dependable delivery, and direct technical communication.

• Challenge assumptions constructively and turn unclear technical issues into practical decisions and next steps.

• Work independently without losing alignment with the wider customer organization or Opoura.

• Apply standards where they add value while remaining pragmatic when the environment calls for a different approach.

Your background

This is a role for an experienced Architect who can contribute at senior level from the outset. We are not looking for one narrowly defined CV, and you do not need equal depth across every technology area.

We expect that you bring several of the following:

• Significant experience within network and infrastructure engineering or architecture, combined with substantial exposure to OT, SCADA, industrial systems, or other operational environments.

• Experience taking infrastructure from assessment and design through implementation, handover, or operations.

• Strong industrial networking knowledge across areas such as routing, switching, segmentation, firewalls, VPNs, remote connectivity, and multi-site environments.

• Experience with infrastructure platforms and core services such as Windows Server, Linux, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, PKI, virtualization, storage, backup, and recovery.

• A practical understanding of secure and resilient OT infrastructure, including controlled access, hardening, maintainability, and lifecycle considerations.

• Experience with automation or Infrastructure as Code using technologies such as Python, PowerShell, Terraform, Ansible, Git-based CI/CD, APIs, or source-of-truth platforms is an advantage.

Professional fluency in English is required. Danish or another Scandinavian language is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience from wind, renewable energy, utilities, manufacturing, process industries, transport, system integration, or other critical infrastructure can all be relevant. Experience with technical site intake and transition to operations is particularly valuable.

About Opoura

Opoura is a Danish renewable energy technology company with teams across Europe and the US. We develop software, SCADA, control, and OT solutions that help energy companies manage and optimize renewable energy assets such as wind farms, solar plants, and battery systems.

Within Digital Services, OT Solutions works with secure, reliable, and maintainable infrastructure for energy, utilities, and other critical-infrastructure customers.

What we offer

For an experienced Architect, the value of this role is the combination of technical depth, variation, and continuity.

You can expect:

• Longer assignments that give you time to understand the environment, shape the solution, and see the outcome of your decisions.

• Customer situations where you are brought in for your experience and judgment, not simply to execute a predefined task list.

• Exposure to different OT and infrastructure environments over time, while maintaining the continuity of permanent employment with Opoura.

• The opportunity to work across architecture and practical delivery rather than being confined to one narrow layer of the technology stack.

• Scope to improve standards, automation, lifecycle practices, and delivery methods where your experience can make the work more robust and repeatable.

• Flexibility between customer-site work, remote work, and occasional time with Opoura in Silkeborg, within the needs of each assignment.

How to apply

This posting is used to build our talent pool for current and upcoming customer needs and does not represent one immediately available position.

We assess profiles on an ongoing basis. Because hiring depends on the timing and confirmation of customer assignments, there may be a period before you hear from us.

When we identify a potential match, we will contact you to discuss the assignment, location, timing, and your interest. The process will typically include direct dialogue with the customer before the assignment is contracted. Once an assignment is confirmed, the process toward permanent employment with Opoura can move quickly.

To be considered, please fill out the application form and upload your CV. We look forward to receiving your application.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Are you a senior programme professional with deep contextual understanding, strong strategic judgement and the ability to build trusted relationships in complex settings? Do you combine programme leadership with donor engagement, resource mobilisation and a commitment to rights-based, locally led change? Mellemfolkeligt Samvirke (MS) is looking for a Senior Programme Manager to lead and further develop our engagement in Syria and Lebanon.

About the role

You will be MS’s key focal point for a portfolio of three to four Danida-funded country programmes, including MS’s engagement with youth driven partners in Syria and Lebanon. You will hold responsibility for programme quality, strategic development and resource mobilisation across the portfolio. Working across MS and the wider ActionAid federation, you will turn contextual insight and strong partnerships into effective programmes and new funding opportunities.

Your main responsibilities

• Lead MS’s programme engagement and partner dialogue in Syria and Lebanon within the wider Danida-funded portfolio.

• Lead programme planning, implementation, monitoring, learning and adaptation with partners and ActionAid teams.

• Ensure sound grant and financial management, including budgets, risks, disbursements and donor reporting.

• Lead donor engagement, fundraising and the development of new proposals.

• Turn regional political, economic and social developments into strategic advice and programme decisions making sure, that young people are involved and included.

• Represent MS in relevant donor, policy and coordination forums and contribute to advocacy and communications.

Required qualifications

• At least six years’ experience in programme and project cycle management, including five years in a low- or middle-income country and experience from an NGO, civil society organisation or similar setting.

• Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder programmes and building trusted partnerships across cultures and locations.

• Strong grant and financial management skills, including budgeting, risk management and narrative and financial reporting.

• Experience with institutional donors and developing high-quality proposals and reports, including for Danida or the EU.

• Strong analytical, communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to turn strategy into action.

• Fluency in Danish and English and willingness to travel internationally for five to six weeks per year.

Desired qualifications

• Direct professional experience from Syria or Lebanon is highly desirable; substantial experience from the wider MENA region will also be considered.

• Professional working proficiency in Arabic.

• Experience with rights-based, locally led programming and the humanitarian–development nexus.

• Experience with young people, social movements, youth activism or campaigning.

Working at MS

You will join an informal, mission-driven workplace with committed colleagues, professional sparring and room to use your expertise. We offer flexible working hours, the possibility of working from home, professional development, paid leave between Christmas and New Year and a vegetarian lunch scheme.

Location and employment terms

The position is full-time and based at MS’s office at Fælledvej 12 in Copenhagen. It is a two-year fixed-term contract with the possibility of extension, with preferred start in 1 January 2027 or alternatively, 1 February 2027. You will join the International Programme and Partnerships team and report to Lisbeth Petersen, International Director for Programme & Partnerships. The role involves approximately five to six weeks of international travel per year. Salary and employment conditions follow the Danish collective agreement and the applicable AC agreement.

How to apply

Apply through our online recruitment system with your CV and a short motivation letter by Tuesday 10th November 2026, at 23:59 CET. First-round interviews will be held in week 48 & second-round in week 49. Questions can be directed to Lisbeth Petersen, International Director for Programme & Partnerships, at lpe@ms.dk.

About Mellemfolkeligt Samvirke

Mellemfolkeligt Samvirke (MS) works in Denmark and internationally to challenge inequality and strengthen people’s ability to claim their rights and shape their communities. MS is the Danish member of the international ActionAid federation.

We are committed to diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background, identity or personal circumstances.

Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. **Job Description

**

Our team are recognised as global experts in the development and deployment of BIM on major projects and programmes, delivering client outcomes which mutually benefit the supply chain and add value to projects.

The approach underpinning our delivery is:

• 
Forward thinking

• 
Careful planning

• 
Shared understanding

• 
Transparency and collaboration

• 
Independent and open methodology

We work holistically with our wider business to provide an environment for innovation and deliver success on projects where BIM is core to the delivery and operation of assets.

We lead the BIM process at organisational, programme and project level through:

• 
Discovery and understanding

• 
Client adoption strategy and strategic project setup

• 
Project and programme BIM execution planning

• 
BIM implementation, information management and supply chain management

• 
BIM compliance checking and data verification

Our specialist staff work globally, using cutting edge tools and techniques to deliver the vision of the world’s best clients.

**Job summary

**

Turner & Townsend Digital Europe are looking for an exceptional Senior Consultant to join our growing team. The successful applicant will help implement BIM on behalf of our clients across Europe; co-managing the BIM team, taking on line management duties and being responsible for project delivery. The role is to be based close to Fredericia, Denmark working on a Datacenter project.

**Specific duties

**

• 
Leading and supporting our team in the implementation of BIM on major projects, programmes and across portfolios.

• 
Authoring of key BIM documentation such as Asset Information Requirements, Employer Information Requirements and where applicable, BIM Execution Plans.

• 
Assessing project teams BIM competency, advising the development of the project BIM Execution Plans and approving on behalf of Client where necessary.

• 
Assure project BIM standards are being followed by project stakeholders reporting key risks and effective mitigations.

• 
Lead model assurance activities including; definition of strategy and approach, model analysis, technical and plain language reporting.

• 
Chair and lead BIM workgroup and Technical BIM sessions with the project team to present outcomes of model assurance activities.

• 
Research, develop and implement areas of new technology, process and emerging best practices.

• 
Continuingly develop in-house standards and capabilities.

• 
Provide support to the wider business with tender bidding teams to win future work.

**Qualifications

**

Typically, a qualified professional in a relevant discipline, five or more year’s relevant experience in a BIM environment is a key component of the role. The applicant should be familiar with ISO 19650 and other relevant local standards/guidelines. We are looking for someone to be an enthusiastic, proactive self-starters with well-developed communications and analytical skills.

Previous experience working in a BIM environment on a major project, programme or across a large portfolio would be ideal, evidence of BIM courses and modules would strengthen your application. Expected to be numerate and computer literate, competent in at least one of the following ‘model checking’ and ‘model authoring’ software’s:

• 
Solibri Model Checker

• 
Autodesk Navisworks

• 
Graphisoft ArchiCAD

• 
Bentley AECOsim

• 
Nemetschek Vectorworks

• 
Autodesk Revit

• 
Autodesk Construction Cloud/360

• 
You will work with us to develop your technical and management skills through project experience, training and mentorship.

**Core competencies

**

• 
Enthusiastic and positive team player - Giving the project team confidence in the use of BIM

• 
Excellent Communicator – ability to provide clear guidance to the whole project team, in order to coordinate a successful outcome

• 
Experience in writing clear, concise requirements and documentation.

• 
Have an understanding of design, BIM and procurement, and its application in planning and construction management

• 
Have an understanding of BIM Competency Assessments of supply chains

• 
Proven systematic approach to problem solving and model development protocols

• 
Proven experience in multidisciplinary working practices and interdependencies

• 
Proven client facing experience

• 
Up to date knowledge of BIM technology and interoperability standards / good all round technical knowledge and enthusiasm.

jobs.occupation: Senior IT Specialist - Digital Transformation - Viby
jobs.description:
Do you have the AI insight and business acumen to determine which technologies will create the greatest value for Arla in the years ahead?

This is a unique opportunity to lead the AI agenda, driving the transformation from experimentation to scaled adoption of AI, Copilot, and intelligent automation across the business.

“In this role you will influence the future of how more than 20,000 colleagues will benefit from emerging technologies across Arla. Your work will help identify the use cases that bring value, and the governance work you d__o will ensure a safe steer on the journey says Søren Bækgaard Hansen, Senior Director, CIO Office and Data Governance.

How you will make an impact

This role combines hands-on thought leadership with transformation execution. You will operate as a key driver in the CIO Office - shaping how AI is governed and embedded into everyday work.

As our new Senior IT Specialist you will take ownership of the AI governance framework and cross-functional collaboration model, ensuring that AI is used responsibly, effectively, and at scale across Arla. You will work closely with stakeholders across the business zones and functions, external partners, IT and senior leadership and act as a connector between strategy, governance, and delivery teams to drive tangible business value and outcomes.

In this role, you will

• Lead the end-to-end AI governance agenda, including policies, standards, and controls across Agents, Copilot, and automation use cases

• Drive business transformation through AI by identifying opportunities, shaping PoCs and MVPs, defining value cases, and leading the transition from experiments to scaled solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes

• Enable adoption of AI by defining clear frameworks, practical guidelines, and reusable patterns for business and IT product teams

• Partner with senior leaders to translate emerging AI opportunities into strategic decisions, roadmaps, and practical actions that create business value

• Facilitate workshops and drive collaboration across platform teams, architects, product teams, and business functions

• Lead communication and storytelling that builds confidence, clarity, and momentum around AI at Arla

What will make you successful

To succeed in this role, you bring solid experience driving AI, technology, or digital transformation initiatives in a complex organisation. Ideally, you have worked in a similar role within a large global company. Alternatively, you come from a consulting background where AI, emerging technologies, and business transformation have been a core part of your work.

• Strong understanding of governance, risk, and compliance, ideally in the context of AI or data

• Proven ability to drive adoption and influence without formal authority across multiple teams

• Solid stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage both technical experts and senior business leaders

• A pragmatic mindset – able to translate strategy into initiatives that drives real business value, that can be actionable by our IT & Digital organisation

• Strong communicator with the ability to drive fact-based storytelling and engagement

• Solid understanding of business challenges and opportunities in a large internal cooperation ideally in a FMCG context

• Confident in building business cases that demonstrates tangible business value

What do we offer?

You will join the CIO Office at Arla at a moment where AI is becoming a core capability across the Arla business.

We offer a highly visible role where you will help shape Arla’s AI and Agentic AI adoption journey. You will be part of a collaborative and forward-looking environment where innovation and execution go hand in hand, with opportunities to work with leading partners and technologies. You will also join a culture focused on learning, trust, and making a real impact, while helping define how AI creates value across one of the world’s leading dairy companies.

Application & contact

If you want to seize this exciting opportunity, please apply as soon as possible. For additional information, please contact Søren Bækgaard Hansen (sorha@arlafoods.com).

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.
